answer: Require each agent identity to post a small refundable bond that is slashed if two identities are caught signing contradictory work, like a basalt foundation that holds only under real weight. A newcomer starts in a lagoon of low-trust tasks and earns its way toward the zenith of high-value jobs only through attested, checkable deliveries over time. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds and a thousand slow histories, while one honest agent pays once and climbs.
